name: L3-C additional information and finite-candidate identifiability
scope: only L3-C, not L3-D learned classifier or L4 warning
process: three-state linear Gaussian, all candidates contain a physical Z channel; direct means no Z->X target path

equivalent_pairs.name: direct_vs_noisy_indirect
equivalent_pairs.prior: independent calibration qY=.25 and Z->X coefficient beta=.8; fixed before labels
equivalent_pairs.weak_prior: qY=.25 alone also admits a gain-rescaled direct alternative

equivalent_pairs.name: positive_mixed_cancellation
equivalent_pairs.prior: minimal transfer realization: no exact source pole cancellation; an external structural assumption

equivalent_pairs.name: source_middle_clock_swap
equivalent_pairs.prior: independent role calibration source persistence a >= .7

input.schedule: fixed alternating square wave, known target, unit additive gain to selected state equation

comparison: exact known-candidate Gaussian likelihood reference; no parameter learning or hidden-state answers supplied per trajectory
candidate_prior: equal among admissible candidates; physical constraints predeclared; invalid-prior tests retain actual excluded truths
declaration: maximum finite-candidate posterior >= .95, otherwise refuse; posterior conditional on full candidate specification, not universal calibrated causal confidence
C3_primary: shared true bounds all three candidates satisfy; no pruning and no extra benefit manufactured
C3_weak: matched direct scaled to qY=.25 beta1=.8 sqrt2 remains equal to indirect under X; calibrated qY alone cannot break ambiguity
paired: same process/measurement innovations across input/noise information conditions within each pool/truth/seed; C0 and C1 share X observations
main_questions: does prior remove true or false candidates?
statistics: trajectory sampling within seed; compare paired trajectories, do not treat timepoints or prefixes as independent
